text:
Ruth (infra): quick post-all-hands note from the infra capacity panel. collecting follow-ups on APAC warmup budget, SLAs for prewarm pools, and procurement cadence. posting short answers and owners here.

Ben (product): could we get a short policy for which routes get prewarm by default? PLG vs paid?

Ruth (infra): default policy: paid routes + critical control-plane routes get prewarm by default. PLG routes are opt-in via project config (we can provide a toggle). owner: Ben + Sandeep to propose the default list.

Claire (finance): what's the expected monthly burn if we keep a steady 4-node prewarm in apac across hosted fleet? rough estimate ok.

Sandeep Rao: rough calc: 4 x T4 equiv nodes * 24h * 30d -> ~288 node-hours/month. at current procurement pricing ~ $X/hr (internal rate) -> ballpark $Y/month. Claire: will follow up with exact INF-4938 cost breakdown.

Mei Wong: procurement update: A100 allocations for dedicated customers arriving in batches. earliest customer onboarding windows: opt-in pools late July; hosted A100 rollout tentative for August pending firmware validation.

Victor (sales): can we offer interim guarantees to enterprise customers while APAC A100 is ramping? e.g., reserved T4 + cross-region SLA?

Ruth (infra): yes - we can craft a hybrid SLA: reserved T4 capacity in-region + cross-region failover with elevated support. legal/ops sign-off required. owner: Victor + Priya (not in thread) + Ruth.

Ben (product): for PLG spikes, what's the short checklist infra recommends to minimize cold-starts?

Sandeep Rao: minimal checklist:
- enable burst_pool on hot routes
- set prewarm_min = 1-3 based on qps
- increase scale_up_threshold to 0.7 for faster ramp
- configure prefix cache for frequent prompts
I'll push a short repo snippet after this.

OpsBot: infra:prewarm-config-snippet pushed to repo infra/playbooks/prewarm.md at 2466012368.

Mei Wong: telemetry question  how will we detect regional exhaustion early? need alert thresholds.

Ruth (infra): plan: 3 alerts -> (1) pool_utilization > 90% for 3m, (2) queue_delay > 200ms for 1m, (3) burst_pool_consumed == true. owner: SRE (Mei + Sandeep) to tune thresholds.

Claire (finance): add a cost alert too so we don't get surprised when cross-region failover kicks in.

Sandeep Rao: agree. cost_alert: actual_cross_region_hours > 10h/day triggers paged alert.

Victor (sales): can we get a customer-facing blurb to explain expected latency+cost for cross-region failover? I can include in renewals.

Ruth (infra): will draft short blurb with numbers (latency delta, cost uplift). assigning INF-4942 to Ruth + Ben.

OpsBot: deploy:infra/alerts/capacity-early-warning v0.9 scheduled to staging at 2466012372 - running smoke checks. :rocket:

Ben (product): propose a 15m sync with PLG, SRE, and Sales next Wed to align defaults and documentation.

Ruth (infra): sounds good. I'll create the invite and attach the prewarm playbook + cost sheet. thanks all! :thumbsup:
